retention.loginAuditMonths: Remove the IP and browser from a sign-in
retention.loginAuditMonthsHelp: After that, the sign-in stays recorded without its IP or browser. From {{min}} to {{max}} months.
retention.loginCodeDaysHelp: They are deleted with their destination and the address that requested them. From {{min}} to {{max}} days: at least one, because the request limits look at the last 24 hours.
retention.invitationDaysHelp: Invitations that are no longer the latest of their account are deleted; the latest always stays. From {{min}} to {{max}} days: at least seven, because an invitation can take a day to be delivered.

confirm.openDescription: From the moment you confirm, anyone with a valid email will be able to create an account and sign in without you adding them. You can switch back whenever you want.
confirm.inviteOnlyDescription: From the moment you confirm, only people you add can sign in. Everyone who already has an account keeps signing in: to lock someone out, deactivate their account.

feedback.uncertain: We could not confirm the save. Check the current values before saving again.
feedback.conflict: Another administrator changed the settings. Check the current values.
feedback.failed: We could not save the settings changes.
feedback.reviewFailed: We could not check the current settings.
feedback.lateUncertain: We could not confirm the settings save. Check the current values.
feedback.lateFailed: We could not save the settings changes.

hints.regional: Initial values for new accounts and public pages. Each person keeps their preferences.
hints.listados: Initial number of rows. Each list can use a different size.
hints.retention: How long sign-in data is kept. The cleanup runs once a day. The privacy policy has to promise these same periods.

appearance.title: Appearance
appearance.brandHint: The logo goes at the top of the menu, on the sign-in pages, in the emails and in the PDFs; the icon, in the browser tab and in the collapsed menu. Both are saved when uploaded; the name and the sender, with Save.
appearance.senderHint: The name people see when they receive an email. The mailbox that sends them is set in the installation.
appearance.logoHint: PNG or JPG up to 1 MB, at least as wide as it is tall. It is saved when uploaded.

issues.singleLine: Write it on a single line, without control characters.
issues.accentContrast: Choose an accent that reads on the menu color.
issues.pieceContrast: Choose a color with more contrast: this one does not read.

appearance.hint: These colors apply to everyone and to sign-in screens.
appearance.name: Name
appearance.saved: We saved the colors and the font.
appearance.iconHint: Square PNG, from 64 to 1024 pixels and up to 1 MB. It is saved when uploaded.

removeDescription.logo: The menu, the sign-in pages, the emails and the PDFs show the application name again.
removeDescription.icon: The browser tab goes back to the usual icon and the collapsed menu has no icon.

fileIssue.logo: “{{name}}” does not work: it must be a PNG or JPG up to 1 MB.
fileIssue.icon: “{{name}}” does not work: it must be a PNG up to 1 MB.

appearance.accentHint: It marks the current item of the menu. It must read on the menu color.
appearance.fontHint: The same font in the whole application. Emails and PDFs keep their own.

pieces.title: Colors by piece
pieces.hint: Each piece comes from the basic colors. If you give it a color, it becomes «Own» and no longer follows them; ↺ returns it to «Automatic». They apply to everyone.
